name: Parsing Japanese Addresses In Japanese
description: Japanese addresses written in Japanese script, read by parseLocation into the Japan fields and the shared ones. Each expected object is matched as a subset of the result.

marunouchi.name: read the full address with 〒, markers, building and floor
marunouchi.input: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内1丁目2番3号 サンプルビル5階

marunouchi.name: read the block written with hyphens
marunouchi.input: 東京都千代田区丸の内1-2-3

marunouchi.name: read full-width digits and dashes
marunouchi.input: 東京都千代田区丸の内１－２－３

marunouchi.name: read kanji numerals before the markers
marunouchi.input: 東京都千代田区丸の内一丁目二番三号

marunouchi.name: read の between the numbers as a dash
marunouchi.input: 東京都千代田区丸の内1の2の3

marunouchi.name: read kanji numerals joined by の
marunouchi.input: 東京都千代田区丸の内一の二の三

marunouchi.name: read a full-width postal code, ideographic spaces and a full-width floor
marunouchi.input: 〒１００－０００５　東京都千代田区丸の内1-2-3　サンプルビル５Ｆ

marunouchi.name: infer Tokyo from the municipality when no prefecture is written
read a prefecture written without 都

postalCode.name: read a postal code with no hyphen
postalCode.input: 〒1000005 東京都千代田区丸の内1-2-3

postalCode.name: read 〒 with no space before the prefecture
read a postal code at the end
read a postal code with no mark at the start
postalCode.input: 100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内1-2-3

postalCode.name: use the postal code for the prefecture when nothing else names it

country.name: take 日本 off the start
country.input: 日本 東京都港区六本木6-10-1

country.name: take 日本 off the end rather than read it as a building
country.input: 東京都港区六本木6-10-1 日本

country.name: keep 日本橋 as a town, not the country

municipalities.name: read a ward with no prefecture as the longest name anywhere, never a shorter one elsewhere
municipalities.input: 大阪市北区梅田3丁目1番1号

municipalities.name: read a kanji-numeral chome with nothing after it as the chome, not a building
municipalities.input: 〒060-0001 北海道札幌市中央区北一条西二丁目

municipalities.name: read a designated city's ward
municipalities.input: 北海道札幌市中央区北一条西3丁目

municipalities.name: read a designated city without its ward, and numbers inside the town's name
read a town written with its district
read a town written without its district
read a Kyoto street name and direction apart from the town, and a lone number as the ban
municipalities.input: 京都府京都市中京区寺町通御池上る上本能寺前町488

municipalities.name: read a municipality in hiragana
municipalities.input: 埼玉県さいたま市大宮区大門町1-1

municipalities.name: read a town in hiragana
municipalities.input: 沖縄県那覇市おもろまち1-1-1

municipalities.name: read a pair after a town without 大字 as ban and go
municipalities.input: 山梨県北杜市大泉町谷戸2-3

municipalities.name: read a pair after a town named with 大字 as ban and go
municipalities.input: 埼玉県比企郡小川町大字下里12-3

municipalities.name: read a pair whose first number is too high for a chome as ban and go
municipalities.input: 奈良県大和郡山市北郡山町248-4

municipalities.name: prefer the longest name: the ward over its city
municipalities.input: 大阪府大阪市北区梅田1-1

municipalities.name: read 大阪狭山市 whole rather than 大阪 and a remainder
read a city with 郡 in its own name
use the postal code to choose between two cities of one name
leave a name two prefectures share unsettled when nothing chooses
keep a municipality named in another prefecture, for validation to report
municipalities.input: 東京都大阪市北区梅田1-1

municipalities.name: keep a municipality not in the table as written

townNames.name: keep the kanji numeral in 三番町
townNames.input: 東京都千代田区三番町6-2

townNames.name: keep the kanji numeral in 麻布十番 while reading the block after it
townNames.input: 東京都港区麻布十番二丁目三番四号

townNames.name: keep the kanji numeral in 三ノ輪
read 番地 after a chome
townNames.input: 北海道札幌市中央区北1条西2丁目1番地

buildings.name: read a building with no floor
buildings.input: 東京都新宿区西新宿2-8-1 東京都庁第一本庁舎

buildings.name: read a building, a floor written F and a room written 号室
buildings.input: 大阪府大阪市北区梅田3-1-3 ノースゲートビル 15F 1501号室

buildings.name: read a building on the same line with no space
buildings.input: 〒100-0005東京都千代田区丸の内1-2-3サンプルビル5階

buildings.name: read 号 after a building as the room
buildings.input: 東京都千代田区丸の内1-2-3サンプルビル501号

buildings.name: read 号 after the block as the go
buildings.input: 東京都千代田区丸の内2丁目7番3号

buildings.name: read a basement floor
buildings.input: 東京都千代田区丸の内1-2-3 サンプルビル 地下1階

buildings.name: keep the long-vowel mark in a building's name while reading it as a dash between digits
buildings.input: 東京都港区台場1ー2ー3 ハーバーランド

buildings.name: read a fourth number after the block as the room
buildings.input: 東京都千代田区丸の内1-2-3-405

rejected.name: return null for Japanese text that names no place
